summary.text: Jabra Muhawieh is the Republican candidate for California State Assembly District 21 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Diane Papan (D).
He is a San Francisco-based business owner, tax professional and real estate broker.

paragraphs.text: Jabra Muhawieh earned a bachelor's degree from Arizona State University.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he began working in his family's businesses at age eight, is an enrolled agent running his own tax preparation and planning firm, helps operate his family's grocery and liquor business that has served San Francisco since 1906, and works as a real estate broker.
He also said he was a batboy and clubhouse attendant for the San Francisco Giants from 2012 to 2016.
Muhawieh advanced from the June 2, 2026 top-two primary for Assembly District 21.
In the survey, he said he supports reducing income and property taxes, reforming or repealing Proposition 19, and cutting regulations on small businesses.
